name: Item scaling: a laddered green looted from a creature scales to the looter's level and keeps its entry
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=5, CoA.ItemScaling=1 and CoA.ItemScaling.Native=1 with ItemStat.dbc in the data directory. The Rake 5807 is a level 10 creature that drops Lionfur Armor 17922 (green, item level 10, required level 5, 108 armor) at 100%. Lionfur Armor has an ItemStat.dbc ladder, so native item scaling keeps the authored entry and gives the looted item its own scaling level, the looter's level 30 (CoA.ItemScaling.Native.LootLevelOffset 0). The ladder row at 30 requires level 27 and carries 174 armor; the item level stays 10. A level 30 character with open-world scaling on sees The Rake at level 25 and with scaling off at 10; both corpses hold the authored entry because the level belongs to the looted item, not to the loot. Client rendering of the item is not tested.

steps.label: Scaling on shows The Rake at 25
The scaled corpse holds the authored Lionfur Armor
The loot window shows the authored item level 10
The loot window shows the authored 108 armor
The looted armor scales to the looter's level 30
The looted armor requires level 27 from its ladder row
The looted armor carries the ladder row's 174 armor
The looted armor keeps item level 10
Scaling off shows The Rake at 10
The unscaled corpse holds the authored Lionfur Armor
The authored item keeps item level 10
